owner_authorization: 30 October 2026 scientific closure brief; scientific exclusion resolved; scoped documentation and public-site correction authorized. Workflow and exact-commit deployment gates retained.
methods_before: A historical FEMW18CHILD output was excluded from the 2026 canonical release because its produced raster values duplicated WOMCHILD. This finding concerns the produced data layer; it does not establish that the two variable names originally represented the same demographic concept. WOMCHILD in the released dataset denotes females ages 15–49, using SUM(P12_030N:P12_039N), and is not a count of mothers. The intended historical FEMW18CHILD source definition has not been verified.
methods_after: An originally proposed female-headed-household indicator was excluded from this release after review identified a mismatch between its documented definition and produced source expression. The historical output duplicated the women-ages-15–49 variable and did not constitute a valid independent household measure. The original source implementation used SUM(P12_030N:P12_039N), which counts female persons ages 15–49 rather than households. The release retains this expression under its correct WOMCHILD definition. No independently verified household-count product corresponding to the intended historical definition was recovered from the inspected project materials.
